ellie.sales: Quick handoff for Navigator Inc. Closed: Dedicated + Private deployment (VPC). 12-month term. Procurement signaled PO delay ~2-4 weeks and asked about a mid-term discount.
tom.cs: Thanks Ellie. Drop SSO, CIDRs, and technical contact here. Any SOC/HIPAA asks?
ellie.sales: Tech contact: infra@navigator.ai. Needs: SAML + SCIM, customer KMS, audit logs, and an analytics webhook to their SIEM. DPA attached in ticket SF-7788.
jana.enablement: I'll own enablement. Planning a 3-week sprint: week0 infra/provision, week1 SSO + SCIM, week2 evals & workflows. Will publish a runbook with acceptance criteria.
omar.support: I'll scope infra work. Need CIDR ranges, SAML metadata, and KMS ARN to finalize ETA. Is webhook over TLS mutual-TLS?
ellie.sales: Uploaded CIDRs, SAML XML, and noted webhook uses mTLS. Ticket SF-7788: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SF-7788
kelly.successops: I'll monitor account health and renewal signal. Proposing weekly check-ins while PO outstanding. Flagging renewal risk: "po-delay" and "discount-requested".
tom.cs: Action items: 1) jana: onboarding runbook + acceptance checklist (48h) 2) omar: scope SF-7788 infra items & ETA (48h) 3) kelly: draft renewal note + dashboard tiles (72h) 4) ellie: confirm mTLS cert contact + SCIM test user (ASAP).
jana.enablement: Starting runbook now. Snippet: - Provision VPC peering & route tables - Request KMS access & test encrypt/decrypt - Deploy private model image: redwood-dedicated-navigator - Configure SAML + SCIM test user sync - Validate CIEM webhook with mTLS - Perf smoke: 3k tokens across 20 concurrent sessions
omar.support: Pulled SF-7788, added infra checklist. ETA tentative 4 business days pending KMS ARN and mTLS cert.
ellie.sales: Pasted mTLS contact and SCIM test user creds into the ticket.
kelly.successops: I'll add dashboard tiles for token usage, error rate, and prompt-eval pass rate and tag renewal risk. Also scheduling weekly syncs until PO clears.
ticket-bot: Support ticket SF-7788 created and assigned to infra-team.
tom.cs: I'll send a kickoff invite for next Tuesday. Keep updates here; ping me for urgent blockers. :calendar:
